title: Request: Being able to display seconds on the clock of the Lock screen
line: The lock screen settings now have a Show seconds option that adds seconds to the lock screen clock.
explanation: The lock screen clock always used the locale's short time format, which has no seconds in almost every locale, and the lock screen had no setting for it. The old LC_TIME workaround no longer helps. The shared Breeze Clock component now has a showSeconds property that adds seconds after the minutes using the locale's own separator (same approach as the Digital Clock widget), and the lock screen appearance settings get a Show seconds checkbox (off by default, disabled when the clock is never shown).

commits.message:
lookandfeel/components: let the clock show seconds

The clock used by the lock screen could only show seconds when the
locale's short time format included them. Add a showSeconds property
that inserts seconds after the minutes, reusing the locale's separator.

BUG: 497348

lockscreen: add an option to show seconds on the clock

There was no way to show seconds on the lock screen clock, which is
handy when the screen is locked but still being watched. Add a Show
seconds checkbox to the lock screen appearance settings, off by default.

BUG: 497348

From 5972eeaf9afdae674e86225547a982fc614e3f6c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 19:04:39 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lockscreen: add an option to show seconds on the clock

There was no way to show seconds on the lock screen clock, which is
handy when the screen is locked but still being watched. Add a Show
seconds checkbox to the lock screen appearance settings, off by default.

BUG: 497348
---
 desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml |  1 +
 desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml       | 13 +++++++++++++
 desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.xml       |  4 ++++
 3 files changed, 18 insertions(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
index 065a33c131..cf9b1b8d31 100644

+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
@@ -268,6 +268,7 @@ Item {
             id: clock
             property Item shadow: clockShadow
             visible: y > 0 && config.alwaysShowClock
+            showSeconds: config.showClockSeconds
             anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
             y: (mainBlock.userList.y + mainStack.y)/2 - height/2

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml
index 0ac9414ae8..d012f9f1d8 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml
@@ -12,6 +12,9 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
     property bool cfg_alwaysShowClockDefault: true
     property bool cfg_hideClockWhenIdleDefault: false
 
+    property alias cfg_showClockSeconds: showClockSeconds.checked
+    property bool cfg_showClockSecondsDefault: false
+
     property alias cfg_showMediaControls: showMediaControls.checked
     property bool cfg_showMediaControlsDefault: false
 
@@ -63,6 +66,16 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
         }
     }
 
+    QQC2.CheckBox {

     QQC2.CheckBox {
         id: showMediaControls
         Kirigami.FormData.label: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop",

index be1577386d..15cd0d3de2 100644

       <label>Hide clock when prompt is hidden.</label>
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="showClockSeconds" type="Bool">
+      <label>Show seconds on the clock.</label>

From 94086bc128bbb49a7e3628403b8d0a8f43a190d2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 19:04:39 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lookandfeel/components: let the clock show seconds

The clock used by the lock screen could only show seconds when the
locale's short time format included them. Add a showSeconds property
that inserts seconds after the minutes, reusing the locale's separator.

BUG: 497348
---
 lookandfeel/components/Clock.qml | 14 ++++++++++++--
 1 file changed, 12 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/lookandfeel/components/Clock.qml b/lookandfeel/components/Clock.qml
index d3d31d1683..b2969dd723 100644
--- a/lookandfeel/components/Clock.qml
+++ b/lookandfeel/components/Clock.qml
@@ -15,10 +15,20 @@ import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 ColumnLayout {
     id: root
 
+    property bool showSeconds: false
+
     readonly property bool softwareRendering: GraphicsInfo.api === GraphicsInfo.Software
+    readonly property string timeFormat: {
+        const format = Qt.locale().timeFormat(Locale.ShortFormat);
+        if (!showSeconds || format.includes("s")) {
+            return format;
+        }
+        // Repeat the separator between hours and minutes before the seconds
+        return format.replace(/(h+)([^m]*)(m+)/i, "$1$2$3$2ss");
+    }
 
     PlasmaComponents3.Label {
-        text: Qt.formatTime(timeSource.dateTime, Qt.locale(), Locale.ShortFormat)
+        text: Qt.locale().toString(timeSource.dateTime, root.timeFormat)
         textFormat: Text.PlainText
         style: root.softwareRendering ? Text.Outline : Text.Normal
         styleColor: root.softwareRendering ? Kirigami.Theme.backgroundColor : "transparent" //no outline, doesn't matter
@@ -42,6 +52,6 @@ ColumnLayout {
 
     PlasmaClock.Clock {
         id: timeSource
-        trackSeconds: Qt.locale().timeFormat(Locale.ShortFormat).includes("s")
+        trackSeconds: root.timeFormat.includes("s")
     }
 }
-- 
2.53.0
